name: @nvault/client
description: Typed TypeScript SDK for the nvault zero-knowledge secrets + parameter platform.
comment:format: CommonJS (no "type":"module") so require("libsodium-wrappers") resolves the package's working CJS entry. Its 0.7.x ESM build is broken — its .mjs imports a libsodium.mjs it never ships. CJS is consumable by Node ESM (named-export interop) and every bundler.
